title: No DuckDB/H2 file-engine confinement in core: admin datasource + schema can read host files and reach the network

criteria.given: a DuckDB datasource opened by Saiku with default settings
criteria.then: core adds enable_external_access=false, an allowed_directories list confined to saiku.home and lock_configuration=true, and applies it in every connection-open path

criteria.given: an H2 datasource URL whose database file lies outside saiku.home
criteria.then: the JdbcUrlPolicy chokepoint rejects it unless the operator has opted out

criteria.given: an operator who needs the previous behaviour
criteria.then: an explicit saiku.jdbc.fileEngineConfinement=false opt-out exists and is documented in docs/operator-hardening.md

criteria.given: an SQLite, Derby or HSQLDB datasource URL whose database file lies outside saiku.home
criteria.then: the JdbcUrlPolicy chokepoint rejects it unless the operator has opted out

criteria.given: a Mondrian datasource whose Catalog references an http(s):// URL
criteria.then: SaikuVirtualFileHandler refuses to fetch it from the network unless the operator has explicitly opted in with saiku.mondrian.allowHttpCatalogs

criteria.given: a connection opened through JdbcUrlPolicy.openConnection(String, Properties) on a DuckDB datasource
criteria.then: the URL gets the same confinement rewrite as the (url, user, password) overload, so no open path reaches the driver unconfined

criteria.given: a DuckDB or Quack URL (or info property) carrying a user-supplied enable_external_access, allowed_directories, allowed_paths, allowed_configs or lock_configuration key
criteria.then: the chokepoint rejects it, so a caller cannot pre-empt or undo the confinement defaults
